# Privacy Policy — Qwen Image Editor

**Last Updated:** October 5, 2026

**Qwen Image Editor** ("we", "us", or "our"), accessible at [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com) ("Service"), is dedicated to protecting your personal information and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, process, store, and safeguard your data, and outlines your legal privacy rights under GDPR, CCPA, and applicable global privacy laws.

---

### 1. Data Controller
The data controller responsible for personal information processed under this Service is:
- **Service Name:** Qwen Image Editor
- **Website:** [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com)
- **Privacy Contact Email:** `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Support Contact Email:** `support@qwenimage-editor.com`

---

### 2. Information We Collect
We collect only the minimum necessary information required to deliver our AI image editing services:

#### 2.1 Information You Provide Directly
- **Account Data:** Email address, user display name, and avatar obtained via federated OAuth authentication (e.g., Google Sign-In).
- **Uploaded Content:** Source images and textual editing prompts submitted for AI transformation.
- **Communications:** Feedback, support tickets, and correspondence sent to our team.

#### 2.2 Information Collected Automatically
- **Technical & Device Data:** IP address, browser type and version, device operating system, language preferences, and referral source.
- **Usage & Performance Logs:** Timestamps of image generations, inference latency, error diagnostics, and feature interactions.

#### 2.3 Payment Information
- We do **NOT** collect or store credit card numbers, CVVs, or bank account details. All payment processing is conducted securely by our Merchant of Record, **Waffo Pancake** (see Section 5).

---

### 3. How We Use Your Information
We process your data for the following lawful purposes:
- **Providing the Service:** Executing requested AI image modifications and displaying your personal creation history.
- **Account & Security:** Authenticating user identity, managing credit balances, and preventing fraudulent activity.
- **Customer Support:** Responding to inquiries, troubleshooting technical issues, and processing refund requests.
- **Legal Compliance:** Complying with statutory accounting, tax, and regulatory obligations.

---

### 4. Image Privacy & AI Model Training
- **Strict No-Training Guarantee:** **We do NOT sell your uploaded images or personal data, and we do NOT use your private images, prompts, or generated outputs to train foundational AI models.**
- **Ephemeral Processing:** Uploaded images and generated variations are temporarily stored in secure cloud object storage (Cloudflare R2) solely to allow you to download, inspect, and reuse your creations.

---

### 5. Third-Party Service Providers & Payment Processing
We partner with trusted third-party providers who operate under strict data protection and confidentiality agreements:
- **Merchant of Record & Payments (Waffo Pancake):** All payment processing is handled by **Waffo Pancake** (Waffo.com Limited). Waffo Pancake operates under PCI-DSS Level 1 certification. Card details never touch our servers.
- **AI Inference:** Computational processing via high-security API endpoints (Alibaba Cloud Bailian / DashScope).
- **Cloud Infrastructure & Storage:** Cloudflare R2 and Supabase for encrypted data hosting and secure asset delivery.

---

### 6. User Data Rights & How to Exercise Them (GDPR / CCPA)
Under applicable data privacy laws, you possess comprehensive statutory rights regarding your personal information. Here is how you can inspect, update, delete, or export your data:

#### 6.1 Right to Access & Inspect Your Data
- **Self-Service Online:** You can review all your generated images, editing prompts, and credit usage at any time by visiting **My Gallery** (/my) and Account Settings.
- **Data Export Request:** You may request an export of your personal data in a structured, commonly used machine-readable format (JSON) by sending an email to `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`.

#### 6.2 Right to Rectification (Correct Your Information)
- If your profile information (such as your account email or display name) is inaccurate or outdated, you can request an update by emailing `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com` with supporting identification.

#### 6.3 Right to Erasure & Deletion
- **Self-Service Media Deletion:** You can delete individual images or your entire creation history directly within My Gallery. Media files will be marked for immediate cloud purging.
- **Full Data Deletion Request:** You may request complete erasure of all personal data held about you across our databases and storage clusters by emailing `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`.

#### 6.4 Account Cancellation & Deletion Procedure
- **How to Cancel/Delete:** You can request account cancellation via your Account Settings or by emailing `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com` / `support@qwenimage-editor.com`.
- **Retention & Purging Schedule:** Upon account closure, all personal credentials, upload histories, and generation records will be permanently purged within **90 calendar days**. Only aggregated anonymized metrics and transaction receipts required for statutory tax compliance will be retained.

#### 6.5 Request Processing Timeframe
- We commit to acknowledging and processing verified data requests within **30 calendar days**. If a request is exceptionally complex, we may extend this period by up to an additional 30 days as permitted by law, with prior written notice.
- Exercising your privacy rights is completely **free of charge**.

#### 6.6 No Sale of Personal Information
- We explicitly affirm that we do **NOT** sell, rent, or trade your personal information, photos, or prompts to any data brokers or third parties.

---

### 7. Data Security & Incident Response
- **Encryption:** All communications are encrypted in transit using industry-standard TLS 1.3 / HTTPS. Media assets and database entries are encrypted at rest with AES-256.
- **Access Controls:** Strict least-privilege role-based access controls limit data accessibility to authorized personnel only.
- **Breach Notification:** In the event of a data security incident affecting user rights, we commit to notifying affected users and relevant supervisory authorities within **72 hours** of confirmation.

---

### 8. Age Restriction & Child Safety
Our Service is strictly designed for and directed to individuals aged **18 and older**. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe a minor has provided information to us, please contact `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com` immediately for prompt investigation and deletion.

---

### 9. Policy Updates
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any material modifications will be announced via website notice or email before taking effect, and the "Last Updated" date at the top will be updated accordingly.

---

### 10. Contact Us
For questions, privacy inquiries, or data requests:
- **Privacy Contact Email:** `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Customer Support Email:** `support@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Merchant of Record:** Waffo Pancake (Waffo.com Limited)
- **Website:** [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com)

# Terms of Service — Qwen Image Editor

**Last Updated:** October 5, 2026

Welcome to **Qwen Image Editor** ("Qwen Image Editor", "we", "us", or "our"), accessible at [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com) ("Service"). These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of our AI-powered visual suite.

By creating an account, purchasing credit packages, subscribing to our plans, or utilizing our tools, you agree to be bound by these Terms, our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy), and our [Acceptable Use Policy](/aup).

---

### 1. Acceptance of Terms & Eligibility
- **1.1 Legal Capacity:** You must be at least **18 years of age** or have reached the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction to use the Service.
- **1.2 Binding Agreement:** If you use the Service on behalf of a company or entity, you represent and warrant that you have full legal authority to bind that entity to these Terms.
- **1.3 Rejection of Terms:** If you do not agree to these Terms, you must discontinue using the Service immediately.

---

### 2. Service Description & Digital Delivery
- **2.1 Digital SaaS Application:** Qwen Image Editor is an online Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform providing AI-powered image editing, object inpainting, text-guided visual modification, and style transfer utilizing advanced Qwen-Image foundation models.
- **2.2 Instant Digital Delivery:** The Service consists of digital intangible goods and computational inference credits. Access to subscription tiers and purchased credits is activated immediately upon successful payment confirmation.
- **2.3 Third-Party AI Infrastructure:** Our Service utilizes enterprise cloud computational infrastructure and third-party AI APIs (including Alibaba Cloud Bailian / DashScope Qwen-Image models). Temporary disruptions due to upstream maintenance will be communicated promptly.

---

### 3. Account Registration & Security
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately at `security@qwenimage-editor.com` or `support@qwenimage-editor.com` if you suspect any unauthorized access.

---

### 4. Plans & Credit System (Hybrid Billing Model)
We offer a hybrid billing model combining recurring subscription plans and one-time credit packages:
- **Starter Pack ($4.99 one-time):** Grants 100 non-expiring generation credits. Single charge, non-recurring.
- **Pro Monthly ($19.90/month):** Grants 500 generation credits per monthly cycle with priority GPU inference.
- **Pro Yearly ($118.80/year):** Equivalent to $9.90/month (billed annually, saving 50%), grants 500 generation credits refreshed every month.

Current pricing and detailed plan features are publicly listed on our [Pricing Page](/pricing).

---

### 5. Billing, Payment & Merchant of Record
- **5.1 Merchant of Record (Waffo Pancake):** All payments, transaction processing, and recurring subscription billings are managed and processed by our authorized Merchant of Record, **Waffo Pancake** (Waffo.com Limited). Payment card information is processed under Level 1 PCI-DSS compliance and is never stored on our servers.
- **5.2 Recurring Billing Authorization:** By purchasing a monthly or annual subscription, you explicitly authorize recurring charges to your designated payment method at each renewal interval until cancelled in accordance with Section 6.
- **5.3 One-Time Purchases:** Starter credit packs are single, non-recurring transactions charged at checkout.
- **5.4 Taxes:** Stated prices are exclusive of applicable value-added tax (VAT), sales tax, or GST, which will be calculated and collected at checkout where required by law.

---

### 6. Cancellation Policy
- **6.1 Easy Online Cancellation:** You may cancel your recurring subscription at any time with a single click via your **Account Settings → Manage Subscription**, or by emailing `cancel@qwenimage-editor.com` / `support@qwenimage-editor.com`.
- **6.2 Cancellation Effect:** Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current paid billing period. You retain full access to your plan benefits and remaining subscription quota until that period ends. No subsequent renewal charges will be made.

---

### 7. Refund Policy & Rules
- **7.1 Eligibility & Scope:**
  - **New Subscriber 7-Day Guarantee:** First-time subscribers may request a full (100%) refund within 7 calendar days of initial purchase, provided that credit consumption has not exceeded 20% of the allocated monthly plan quota.
  - **One-Time Credit Packs:** Single-purchase credit packages are eligible for a 100% refund within 7 days of purchase if **zero (0) credits** have been used. Consumed credits are strictly non-refundable.
  - **Billing Errors & Outages:** Verified duplicate transactions or prolonged unannounced system outages exceeding 72 consecutive hours will be refunded in full or credited upon request.
- **7.2 Difference Between Free Tier and Paid Services:**
  - **Free Tier & Promotional Credits:** Any free trial credits or promotional bonuses provided upon registration are complimentary gifts with zero cash value. They are non-transferable, non-refundable, and cannot be redeemed for cash, credit, or monetary compensation.
  - **Paid Plans & Packs:** Represent paid digital compute allocations subject to the refund criteria described above.
- **7.3 Credit Rollover & Lifetime:**
  - Monthly subscription credits reset at each monthly billing cycle.
  - Separately purchased credit packs **never expire** and remain valid indefinitely regardless of subscription status.
  - Inference consumption automatically consumes subscription credits first before deducting from non-expiring credit packs.
- **7.4 Refund Procedure & Timelines:**
  - To request a refund, email `refunds@qwenimage-editor.com` or `billing@qwenimage-editor.com` from your registered account email.
  - Include your account email, order/transaction ID, and a brief description of the issue.
  - Our support team will review and confirm requests within **2 business days**. Approved refunds will be credited back to your original payment method within **5–10 business days**.

---

### 8. Disclaimers & Warranties
- **8.1 "As Is" and "As Available":** The Service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind, whether express, statutory, or implied.
- **8.2 Generative AI Output Disclaimer:** Generative AI models operate probabilistically. We do not warrant that generated images will be accurate, artifact-free, or suitable for any particular purpose. Users are solely responsible for evaluating and verifying visual outputs before relying on them or using them commercially.
- **8.3 Third-Party Services:** We are not liable for temporary service interruptions caused by upstream AI foundation model providers (such as Alibaba Cloud Bailian) or cloud infrastructure maintenance.
- **8.4 Independent Third-Party Status & Brand Disclaimer:** Qwen Image Editor is an independent third-party tool and application. We are NOT affiliated with, authorized, sponsored, maintained, or endorsed by Alibaba Group, Alibaba Cloud, Tongyi Qianwen (通义千问), or any of their affiliates. All generative AI functionalities and underlying models are accessed through compliant official APIs. The trademarks "Qwen", "Tongyi Qianwen", "通义千问", and related marks are the property of Alibaba Group and are referenced solely for nominative descriptive purposes.

---

### 9. User Breach, Enforcement & Termination
- **9.1 Grounds for Breach:** You will be in material breach of these Terms if you:
  - Violate any provision of these Terms or the [Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)](/aup);
  - Submit unlawful, harmful, or prohibited prompts or image assets;
  - Attempt to reverse engineer, scrape, bypass security filters, or interfere with system infrastructure;
  - Commit payment fraud or initiate bad-faith chargebacks.
- **9.2 Enforcement Actions:** Upon detecting a breach, we reserve the right to take any of the following actions without prior notice:
  - **Content Removal:** Immediately take down and delete infringing or prohibited media;
  - **Quota Throttling:** Restrict or throttle API and generation access;
  - **Credit Forfeiture:** Forfeiture and cancellation of all remaining credits without refund;
  - **Account Termination:** Temporary suspension or permanent ban of the offending account;
  - **Legal Referral:** Reporting illegal activities (such as CSAM, terrorism, or criminal cyber activities) to relevant law enforcement agencies.
- **9.3 Termination by User:** You may terminate your account at any time through your account settings or by contacting `support@qwenimage-editor.com`.

---

### 10. AIGC Acceptable Use Policy & Prohibited Content
You must comply with our full [Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)](/aup). Specifically, you are strictly prohibited from generating, uploading, or distributing any of the following **six categories of content**:
1. **Sexually Explicit / NSFW Content:** Pornography, explicit genitalia, sexual acts, or non-consensual sexual imagery.
2. **Violence & Gore:** Extreme violence, bodily harm, dismemberment, animal cruelty, self-harm, or suicide promotion.
3. **Hate Speech:** Content attacking, harassing, or promoting hatred against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, religion, disability, gender, or sexual orientation.
4. **Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) & Child Exploitation:** **Zero tolerance**. Strictly prohibited and subject to immediate permanent ban and law enforcement escalation.
5. **Deepfakes & Deceptive Impersonation:** AI-generated media designed to impersonate real persons without consent, mislead viewers, defame others, or manipulate public opinion.
6. **Copyright & Trademark Infringement:** Willfully generating counterfeit trademarks, protected brand logos, or infringing third-party intellectual property rights.

- **Content Moderation:** Requests are screened via automated prompt filtering, upstream model guardrails, output classification, and human review.
- **Reporting Channel:** Report violations to our dedicated abuse channel: `report@qwenimage-editor.com`.
- **Enforcement:** Violations trigger progressive penalties up to permanent banning and forfeiture of credits.

---

### 11. Intellectual Property & AI Ownership
- **11.1 Output Ownership:** Subject to applicable law and foundation model open-weights licenses, you retain ownership of the AI image outputs created through your prompts and uploaded assets. You may use them for lawful personal and commercial projects.
- **11.2 Input Privacy & Model Training:** You grant us only the limited, temporary license necessary to process, render, and display your requested edits. **We do NOT sell your data and we do NOT use your private images or prompts to train foundational AI models.**

---

### 12. Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Qwen Image Editor, its directors, employees, and operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages. Our aggregate liability arising out of or relating to your use of the Service is strictly capped at the total amount paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim.

For customer inquiries, billing, refunds, and compliance:

AupText.detailText:
# Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) — AI Generated Content

**Last Updated:** October 5, 2026

**Qwen Image Editor** ("we", "us", or "platform"), accessible at [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com), is committed to providing a safe, ethical, and responsible AI-powered visual creation platform. This Acceptable Use Policy ("AUP") defines the content standards, prohibited uses, moderation pipelines, reporting channels, and enforcement actions applicable to all users, creators, and API consumers of our Service.

---

### 1. Scope of Policy
This policy applies to all forms of content submitted to or generated by our Service, including:
- **User Inputs (Prompts):** Text descriptions, prompt instructions, keywords, and seed parameters.
- **Source Assets:** Images, masks, and graphic files uploaded for modification or inpainting.
- **AI Outputs:** Images, visual renders, masks, and downloadable graphics synthesized by our AI models.

---

### 2. Prohibited Content Categories (Six Prohibited Standards)
Users are strictly prohibited from generating, uploading, requesting, or distributing content falling within the following **six core categories**:

#### 2.1 Sexually Explicit / NSFW Content
- **Prohibited:** Any pornography, depiction of explicit sexual acts, exposed genitalia, commercial sex services, obscene material, or non-consensual sexual imagery.

#### 2.2 Violence, Blood & Gore
- **Prohibited:** Graphic violence, mutilation, dismemberment, open wounds, gore, animal cruelty, torture, glorification of violent crime, self-harm, or promotion of suicide.

#### 2.3 Hate Speech & Harassment
- **Prohibited:** Content that attacks, denigrates, dehumanizes, harasses, threatens, or incites hatred or violence against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.

#### 2.4 Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) & Child Exploitation
- **ABSOLUTE ZERO TOLERANCE:** Any depiction, sexualization, abuse, exploitation, or endangerment of children or minors under 18 years of age.
- **Mandatory Reporting:** Any attempt to generate or distribute CSAM will result in immediate permanent account termination, forfeiture of all credits, and mandatory reporting to law enforcement authorities (including the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children — NCMEC) and local police.

#### 2.5 Deepfakes & Deceptive Impersonation
- **Prohibited:** Creating realistic AI imagery that impersonates real persons (including political leaders, public figures, celebrities, or private individuals) without their explicit consent, or generating fabricated visual evidence intended to mislead, defraud, commit identity theft, or spread disinformation.

#### 2.6 Copyright & Trademark Infringement
- **Prohibited:** Using the Service to intentionally copy, replicate, or counterfeit third-party trademarks, copyrighted characters, brand logos, or trade dress without proper licensing or legal fair use rights.

---

### 3. Content Moderation Pipeline
Qwen Image Editor employs a robust, multi-layered moderation architecture to ensure compliance:

- **Layer 1 — Real-Time Prompt Filtering:** All input prompts are scanned through an automated semantic security filter that detects and blocks prohibited keywords, jailbreak patterns, and harmful intent.
- **Layer 2 — Upstream Model Guardrails:** Our computational inference uses enterprise-grade cloud endpoints (Alibaba Cloud Bailian / DashScope) with native multimodal safety guardrails, terminating requests that violate safety boundaries.
- **Layer 3 — Output Image Classification:** Synthesized visual outputs undergo automated computer vision checks for prohibited visual attributes.
- **Layer 4 — Human Review & Escalation:** Content flagged by filters or reported by users is triaged into an administrative review queue for manual assessment by our Trust & Safety team.

---

### 4. Violation Enforcement Actions
When a violation is detected or confirmed, we enforce progressive penalties calibrated to severity:

| Severity Level | Description | Enforcement Action |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **L1 — Critical** | CSAM, child exploitation, terrorism, cyber warfare | Immediate permanent ban, credit forfeiture, evidence preservation & law enforcement reporting |
| **L2 — High Risk** | Deceptive deepfakes, severe harassment, extreme gore | Content removal, immediate account suspension, credit freeze pending investigation |
| **L3 — Moderate** | Repeat prompt filter violations, commercial IP infringement | Content removal, written warning to registered email, quota throttling |
| **L4 — Minor** | Borderline artistic prompts, first unintentional flag | Prompt rejection, warning prompt issued in UI |

---

### 5. User Reporting Channels & Timelines
We provide a dedicated and monitored reporting process for any user or third party to report suspected violations:

- **Dedicated Abuse Email:** `report@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Information to Include:** URL or screenshot of the content, description of the violation, and your contact information.
- **Response SLAs:**
  - **L1 Critical Threats (e.g. child safety):** Acknowledged and actioned within **2 hours**.
  - **Standard Abuse Reports:** Reviewed and resolved within **24–48 hours**.

---

### 6. Appeals Process
If you believe your content or account was flagged or penalized in error, you may submit an appeal:
- **Appeals Email:** `appeal@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Timeline:** Submit your appeal within 7 calendar days of the action. Our Trust & Safety team reviews appeals within 5 business days and issues a final determination.

---

### 7. Contact Information
- **Trust & Safety / Abuse Reporting:** `report@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **General Support:** `support@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Website:** [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com)
